 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 4 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) You know that the cosmos has been kind and you truly are blessed, Cancer . There has been a shift of perspective underway—an expansion of sorts. And as much as you thought you knew what you wanted in the past, you do recognise that in some form or the other you already are blessed with it. Your heart is set on new horizons, on all that is possible for you and honestly, the shiny exhibits of the world don’t entice you anymore. Do you want to have a stable, solid, comfortable life? Yes. But is your self-worth and esteem dependent on how the world views you or thinks of you? Not entirely—in fact, it's safe to say not at all. This is tremendous inner work in the right direction. Continue to stay anchored in your truth because this is what helps you stay adaptive and assert your healthy boundaries.
 Cosmic tip: Your money is on your heart, and the cosmos is leading you to it in a very grounded and balanced manner.
